slides.title: Do the isoforms differ in RNA-binding localization?
findings: Compare MSI2 324 with MSI2 328 in matched CLIP/SMI libraries.
CLIP measures MSI2-associated RNA. SMI provides an RNA/background comparison.
The investigation developed from broad binding differences into questions about 3′UTRs and splice-associated regions.
slides.changed: We began with a binding-localization question, without assuming a splicing mechanism.
slides.note:
Biological setup follows supplied project description. Isoform labels are construct identifiers. No PSI or functional splicing measurements appear in this analysis.

slides.title: How much usable sequencing did each library provide?
slides.why: The eight libraries contain two biological replicates for each construct and assay.
findings: 324 CLIP: 93,659 and 103,812 records.
328 CLIP: 148,054 and 173,852 records.
SMI depths are larger and also differ by construct.
slides.changed: Sparse 324 CLIP became a central alternative explanation.
slides.note:
Raw FASTQ totals are unavailable in these exports. These are eligible mapped BAM records after upstream collapsing and filtering, not raw sequencing reads. Library IDs and biological pair A/B are preserved.

slides.title: Which alternative explanations still worried us?
findings: Unequal depth and sparse 324 CLIP could amplify pseudocount effects.
SMI composition could influence the denominator.
Peak filters could select a particular transcript landscape.
Large N could produce small P-values for small effects.
slides.changed: We tested normalization, depth, assay components and the unit being averaged.
slides.note:
These are methodological concerns motivating the saved analyses. They are not independent confirmed sources of bias.

slides.title: Could unequal depth alone explain the 328 preference?
slides.why: Random sampling tests the depth concern without relying only on mathematical normalization.
findings: Sample whole aligned records without replacement.
CLIP target: 93,659 records per library.
SMI target: 257,457 records per library.
50 independent draws, seed 260921.
slides.changed: This directly tested unequal depth while retaining each biological replicate.
slides.note:
SMI uses its own minimum, which is a 328 library. All-peak overlap reconstruction differs slightly from historical featureCounts without -O. Comparisons hold the reconstruction rule constant.

slides.title: Could SMI be creating the donor contrast?

A/B arithmetic means are not interchangeable with means of log terms in C/D. Decomposition follows the saved mathematical identity, not a causal attribution.

Weighting and support: sparse sites make the averaging unit decisive.
Peak and external tests: sharp read extrema have weak called-site support.
Current view: construct-associated differences, with broader spatial conclusions than an immediate splice-binding claim.
